name: Sweet Potato and Egg Hash
method: Dice the sweet potato, chop the onion and deseed and chop the pepper.
Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the sweet potato for 10 minutes until soft and golden. Add the onion, pepper and paprika and cook for 3 minutes.
Make two wells in the hash, crack in the eggs, cover the pan and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until the whites are set.
Season with salt and pepper and serve straight from the pan.
